subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI messages can reach shared context but still not appear in Open WebUI visible chat history

question: Should OpenClaw core own syncing external Control UI turns into Open WebUI’s visible chat history, and if so through which supported boundary?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear from source and discussion, but the implementation direction depends on maintainer intent for third-party Open WebUI persistence ownership, direct SQLite coupling versus API/adapter/plugin integration, opt-in configuration, and historical backfill behavior.

options.title: Design opt-in visible-history sync
options.body: Keep this issue open and define a narrow Open WebUI sync contract with explicit configuration, schema/version handling, and live Docker/OpenWebUI proof before implementation.

options.title: Move it behind a plugin or adapter
options.body: Keep core lean by requiring Open WebUI-specific mirroring to live behind a plugin or integration boundary, adding only any missing core API seam if needed.

options.title: Document unsupported co-editing
options.body: Decide that OpenClaw owns transcript/model context only for this workflow and document that Control UI sends do not update Open WebUI visible history.

recommendation.title: Design opt-in visible-history sync
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and define a narrow Open WebUI sync contract with explicit configuration, schema/version handling, and live Docker/OpenWebUI proof before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily a product and persistence-boundary decision, and steipete appears in adjacent Open WebUI smoke and inbound dispatch history as well as the issue timeline.
